name: aekasha-js
description: High-performance WebGPU application powered by the Ækasha framework.
author: JarSeal

engine_metadata.name: Ækasha
engine_metadata.description: The 'fifth element' of web development: a modular, high-performance WebGPU framework built on Three.js and the Ækasha ECS.
engine_metadata.author: JarSeal

toolkit_metadata.name: Ækasha Toolkit
toolkit_metadata.description: Ready-made ECS components, modules, models, textures, and shaders for Ækasha: bring in only what you need, as-is, or copy it into your app and make it your own.

app_metadata.name: Example App
app_metadata.description: Project template utilizing the Ækasha modular toolkit.

scripts.dev: yarn copyDracoDecoders && yarn gatherAppData && VITE_APP_ENV=development vite serve --port 8080 --host
scripts.dev:test: yarn copyDracoDecoders && yarn gatherAppData && VITE_APP_ENV=test vite serve --port 8080 --host
scripts.dev:production: yarn copyDracoDecoders && yarn gatherAppData && vite serve --port 8080 --host
scripts.build: yarn copyDracoDecoders && NODE_ENV=production yarn gatherAppData && tsc && vite build && yarn gatherAppData
scripts.build:test: yarn copyDracoDecoders && NODE_ENV=production yarn gatherAppData && tsc && VITE_APP_ENV=test vite build && yarn gatherAppData
